items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that where Nash is playing now? [INTERVIEWEE] No, there's nobody there now.

ctx.x: And, uh, I have a chance, uh, to get possession of it for next year.
Is that where Nash is playing now?
